QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] The Five-Color Hill Special 2
QuestInfo.0: You decide to make a huge sandwich with help from Simia and the Pi siblings. The key to a good sandwich is the balance of ingredients. So... what will you need?
QuestInfo.1: You decide to make a huge sandwich with help from Simia and the Pi siblings. The key a good sandwich is the balance of ingredients.\r\n\r\nDefeat Ewenana and Ramanana to get Greasy Peels and Sour Peels.
QuestInfo.2: You can't make a sandwich without fresh greens. After tasting the ingredients, your new friends suggested you could get something similar-tasting from Ewenana and Ramanana. And you know what? They were right!

default.0: Did you gather all the ingredients? Gulla's going to attack soon. We have to hurry.
